name: Real Kayak
summary:
Grab your paddle, hop into your kayak, and embark on a journey of pure relaxation.
Explore a boundless 3D world with the freedom to steer wherever your heart desires.

To deliver the ultimate kayaking experience, we’ve developed a brand-new physics engine. From the resistance of the water to the precise haptic feedback of every stroke—it feels just like the real thing.

Experience truly interactive water: watch as every stroke creates ripples that react just as they would in nature.
